title: Wynn and DSAL Jointly Organize "Wynn Occupational Safety and Health Month 2026"

body_markdown:
*Working Together for a Safer, Healthier and Better Workplace*


**Macao, November 6, 2026 –** To further raise team members' awareness of occupational safety and health (OSH) and continuously strengthen the OSH culture, Wynn and the Labour Affairs Bureau (DSAL) of the Macao SAR Government jointly organized "Wynn Occupational Safety and Health Month 2026" in October. In partnership with the Social Welfare Bureau of the Macao SAR Government, Kiang Wu Hospital, Medicare, and the Chong Wing Center of the Macau Association of the Hearing Impaired, Wynn held an array of activities focused on occupational safety, physical and mental health, and risk prevention across four weeks, encouraging team members to integrate the principles of safety and health into their work. On November 3, a launch and recognition ceremony was held at Wynn Palace, marking the start of new OSH initiatives for the year ahead. The ceremony also celebrated the achievements of the OSH month, further encouraging team members to put OSH principles into practice together.


Mr. Chan Chon U, Deputy Director of DSAL, said: "OSH is an important cornerstone for a company's sustainable development. Wynn has long been a supporter and participant of DSAL's various OSH initiatives. In recent years, Wynn has also used innovative technology to advance OSH and continued to strengthen regional exchange and cooperation, helping to raise OSH standards in Macao. In addition, the eight editions of the 'Healthy Workplace Lifestyle' Roadshow co-organized by DSAL and Wynn have attracted a total of 28,000 participants, demonstrating Wynn's long-term commitment and investment in OSH and its steadfast determination to foster a healthy workplace."


Ms. Stephanie So, Senior Vice President of Human Resources of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace, noted in her speech: "OSH is not only about management, but also a culture that should be integrated into the daily routine of each and every team member. Over the years, Wynn has worked with DSAL and all sectors of society to advance OSH. Through technological innovation, professional training, and company-wide participation, we have put safety and health principles into practice across every role. As we celebrate Wynn's 20th anniversary in Macao, we will continue to honor our commitment to team members' safety and health and work together to build a safer and healthier workplace."


The "Wynn Occupational Safety and Health Month" has become an annual event of the company. Themed "Working Together for Safety and Well-being, Building a Better Workplace at Wynn", the event this year featured a wide range of activities in Wynn's back-of-house areas, including game booths, interactive experiences, OSH quizzes and talks. Through these activities, Wynn aims to help team members deepen their understanding of OSH, identify potential workplace hazards and learn how to prevent them, thereby encouraging everyone to integrate the principles of OSH into their daily work and lives.


At the launch ceremony, Wynn presented souvenirs to DSAL and co-organizers in appreciation of their long-standing support for promoting OSH culture. This was followed by the finals of an occupational safety and health quiz and a stretching competition. Award were presented to the winners in recognition of their enthusiastic efforts to advance OSH culture, while encouraging more team members to embrace safe and healthy work practices.


Other attending guests included: Mr. Chui Ka Shing, Head of the Promotion and Training Division of the Occupational Safety and Health Department of DSAL; Mr. Philipp Knuepfer, Executive Vice President of Non-Gaming Operations of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace; Mr. Jean-Marc Dizerens, Senior Vice President of Food & Beverage of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace; Mr. Pankaj Rawat, Senior Vice President of Security of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace; Mr. Thomas Lau, Vice President of Human Resources of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace; Ms. Grace Chan, Vice President of Hotel Services of Wynn Palace; Mr. Vivas Lo, Vice President of Facilities of Wynn Palace; and Ms. Maggie Wong, Director of Casino Operations of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace.
